description: Phase B1: Install web research + test live search

commands.description: Pull all updated files (web_operations, engine, tools, fast_router)
commands.command: git fetch origin && git checkout origin/phase-3/gui-operations -- src/execution/web_operations.py src/execution/engine.py src/intelligence/default_tools.py src/intelligence/fast_router.py

commands.description: Kill old agent and restart with new code
commands.command: taskkill /f /fi "WINDOWTITLE eq *daemon*" 2>nul & taskkill /f /fi "IMAGENAME eq python.exe" /fi "MEMUSAGE gt 50000" 2>nul & echo Agent processes cleared
python -c "from src.execution.web_operations import web_search, fetch_url; print('OK - web module loaded')"

commands.description: Test web search directly (no agent needed)
commands.command: python -c "from src.execution.web_operations import web_search; import json; r = web_search('Dubai real estate 2026'); print(json.dumps(r, indent=2)[:500])"
